J. Sheridan Le Fanu, Short Fiction.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/j-sheridan-le-fanu/short-fiction

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- J. Sheridan Le Fanu, the author, died 1873.

First publication of the text used: 1838 to 1874 (the stories were first published between 1838 and 1874; SE colophon: 'Short Fiction includes stories published between 1838 and 1874 by J. Sheridan Le Fanu.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: each story was first published between 1838 and 1874, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so every story had entered it by 1969.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1873 or earlier (the last to die, J. Sheridan Le Fanu, in 1873), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
